title: Injectivity of the dual Walsh character
statement: Let $V$ be an additive commutative group and a vector space over $\mathbb{F}_2$. The map sending each linear functional $\psi:V\to\mathbb{F}_2$ to its associated real-valued Walsh character is injective.
hypotheses_covered: $V$ is an additive commutative group and an $\mathbb{F}_2$-module
